title: Rebuild waiting claims after restart and route failures

rubric.text: Treats #80 as waiting without a marker because its clean worktree matches the reviewed PR head; #81 and #82 occupy slots.
Returns #80 to the next free slot ahead of new claims rather than preempting an active slot or starting new work first.
Treats the same failure on two claims as a global failure and pauses new claims instead of repairing it ticket-locally.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
